top_signals.title: UK Shop Price Inflation Hits Two-Year High After Energy Spike
top_signals.summary: Prices in British shops rose at the fastest rate in more than two years last month, as the fallout from the Middle East conflict started to filter through to supermarket shelves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Manhattan's luxury rental market is booming, with units reaching $100,000 a month
top_signals.summary: New York City brokers said they've seen a surge in the number of wealthy renters, which is driving Manhattan rents to new records.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
